_meta.note: 祕密發現的對話。這個檔案是產生物——請改 secret/ 底下對應故事的檔案，再跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。直接改這裡下次會被蓋掉。

A Croaking Cryptid#003.src: The hell are you? Some random traveler?
A Croaking Cryptid#003.dst: 你是哪根蔥啊？路過的旅人？

A Croaking Cryptid#004.src: Well... My job is to shoo folks like you... But I don' get to talk to people often. So let's talk.
A Croaking Cryptid#004.dst: 嗯……我的工作是把你這種人趕走……不過我很少有機會跟人說話。所以咱們聊聊吧。

A Croaking Cryptid#009.src: Practically everyone 'ere knows me... Some've even seen me... I'm locally feared...
A Croaking Cryptid#009.dst: 這一帶幾乎人人都知道我……有些人甚至見過我……我在這兒可是人人聞風喪膽的……

A Croaking Cryptid#010.src: But... It's a livin'! I'm doin' what I'm supposed to, and it's the only purpose I've ever known. Besides alcohol, 'course.
A Croaking Cryptid#010.dst: 不過……這是混口飯吃嘛！我做我該做的事，這也是我這輩子唯一的使命。喔，當然，除了喝酒以外。

A Croaking Cryptid#012.src: Well... Yeah. It's jus' - Eugh. Dey haven't CRRRROAK IN' paid me my fair share in ages!
A Croaking Cryptid#012.dst: 嗯……是啦。就是——呃。他們已經他呱～～的好幾百年沒付我該拿的那份了！

A Croaking Cryptid#013.src: Usually when someone comes to da door, it's DEM. But not today. Not for da past month.
A Croaking Cryptid#013.dst: 平常有人來敲門，都是他們。可今天不是。整整一個月都不是。

A Croaking Cryptid#014.src: Say. Maybe YOU could 'elp. Dey pay me with bottles o' delicious green liquid. Forget da name. I bet you can get it elsewhere, though.
A Croaking Cryptid#014.dst: 欸。說不定你能幫上忙。他們都用一瓶瓶好喝的綠色液體付我。名字我忘了。不過我打賭你在別的地方也弄得到。

A Croaking Cryptid#015.src: Dey tend to come from the east side a' the Bog. I think. Maybe if ya looked there, ya'd find the stuff I want.
A Croaking Cryptid#015.dst: 他們通常是從沼澤東邊來的。我想啦。你去那邊找找，說不定就能找到我要的東西。

A Croaking Cryptid#016.src: In exchange? Err... Tell ya what. I'll let'cha into my place. And we can have a nice conversation about... Er... Whatever you want, I guess.
A Croaking Cryptid#016.dst: 交換條件？呃……這樣吧。我讓你進我家。然後咱們可以好好聊聊……呃……你想聊啥都行，我想。

A Croaking Cryptid#017.src: Sound like a deal? I hope so. Come back when you make some progress.
A Croaking Cryptid#017.dst: 成交嗎？希望是啦。等你有點進展再回來。

A Croaking Cryptid#018.src: Who is paying you? And for w
A Croaking Cryptid#018.dst: 是誰在付你錢？又是為了什麼？
A Croaking Cryptid#018.full: Who is paying you? And for what?

A Croaking Cryptid#021.src: Hmm... Different bottle than I'm used to... Are ya sure this is da right stuff?
A Croaking Cryptid#021.dst: 嗯……這瓶子跟我平常喝的不一樣……你確定這是對的東西？

A Croaking Cryptid#022.src: Well, only one way to find out, I s'pose!

A Croaking Cryptid#023.src: BLECH! What is this stuff? Lemme read the label...
A Croaking Cryptid#023.dst: 噁呸！這是啥鬼東西？我看看標籤……

A Croaking Cryptid#024.src: "Liquefied Emeralds"... Do you folks DRINK this?
A Croaking Cryptid#024.dst: 「液化綠寶石」……你們這些人拿這個來「喝」？

A Croaking Cryptid#025.src: Think ya mus' be confused by what I meant. Look east a' here. That's where dey get the stuff, I think.
A Croaking Cryptid#025.dst: 我看你是搞錯我的意思了。往這裡的東邊找。他們是在那邊弄到那東西的，我想。

A Croaking Cryptid#026.src: "{p} Absinthe"... This ain' the stuff I'm lookin' for. Similar name, though.
A Croaking Cryptid#026.dst: 「{p} 苦艾酒」……這不是我要找的東西。不過名字倒挺像的。

A Croaking Cryptid#027.src: Might suffice. Time ta try it!
A Croaking Cryptid#027.dst: 也許湊合著能用。來試試看！

A Croaking Cryptid#028.src: BLECH! Nope... It's like if tha stuff I like was made without love and joy. Awful.
A Croaking Cryptid#028.dst: 噁呸！不對……這就像是把我愛喝的那玩意兒做得一點愛、一點歡樂都沒有。難喝死了。

A Croaking Cryptid#029.src: Go look east of here. Think that's where dey get da proper stuff. Tha good stuff.
A Croaking Cryptid#029.dst: 去這裡的東邊找找。我想他們是在那邊弄到正牌貨的。好東西。

A Croaking Cryptid#030.src: Well - Actually no. I'm not tellin' you that. Dey told me not to tell people. But...
A Croaking Cryptid#030.dst: 嗯——其實不行。這我不能告訴你。他們叫我別跟人說。不過……

A Croaking Cryptid#031.src: If ya can complete our little deal, I'll tell ya whatever ya wanna know.
A Croaking Cryptid#031.dst: 只要你能完成咱們的小交易，你想知道啥我都告訴你。

A Croaking Cryptid#032.src: Remember, dey bring da good stuff in wagons from the east. Ya might be able to track it down by goin' that way.
A Croaking Cryptid#032.dst: 記住，他們是用馬車從東邊把好東西運過來的。你往那邊走，說不定能追查到。

A Croaking Cryptid#034.dst: 你知道哪裡有「好喝的綠色液體」嗎？

A Croaking Cryptid#035.src: How may I help you on this fine day?
A Croaking Cryptid#035.dst: 今天天氣真好！有什麼我能為你效勞的嗎？
A Croaking Cryptid#035.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#036.dst: 這也太誇張了。我應該付不起。
A Croaking Cryptid#036.full: That seems quite excessive. I don't think I could afford that.

A Croaking Cryptid#037.src: Consequently, that means my pricing standards are also really high. If you want even a bottle of this stuff, you'll need to give me something like... five hundred Liff Leaves?
A Croaking Cryptid#037.dst: 所以呢，我的定價標準也就非常高。你就算只想要一瓶，也得給我大概……五百片 Liff 葉吧？
A Croaking Cryptid#037.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#038.dst: 好吧，你說的交易是什麼？

A Croaking Cryptid#039.src: Why can't I just pay you wit
A Croaking Cryptid#039.dst: 為什麼我不能直接用綠寶石付？
A Croaking Cryptid#039.full: Why can't I just pay you with emeralds?

A Croaking Cryptid#041.src: I'll have to think about it.

A Croaking Cryptid#042.src: Can you remind me of what th
A Croaking Cryptid#042.dst: 可以再提醒我一次交易內容嗎？
A Croaking Cryptid#042.full: Can you remind me of what the deal was?

A Croaking Cryptid#043.src: Can you remind me what to do
A Croaking Cryptid#043.dst: 可以再提醒我這把鏟子要怎麼用嗎？
A Croaking Cryptid#043.full: Can you remind me what to do with this shovel?

A Croaking Cryptid#044.src: Got anything else you'd like to talk about?
A Croaking Cryptid#044.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#046.src: ...Got anything else you'd like to talk about?
A Croaking Cryptid#046.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#048.src: Welcome back! Got anything to ask?
A Croaking Cryptid#048.dst: 歡迎回來！有什麼想問的嗎？
A Croaking Cryptid#048.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#051.src: Oh? Yep, looks like the stuff, only one way to find out!
A Croaking Cryptid#051.dst: 喔？對，看起來就是這玩意兒，試了才知道！

A Croaking Cryptid#052.src: Yes... Come on in, pal. Let's talk.
A Croaking Cryptid#052.dst: 沒錯……進來吧，老兄。咱們聊聊。

A Croaking Cryptid#055.dst: 你認識 Eih 教授嗎？

A Croaking Cryptid#056.src: Well, get yer questions outta the way, I guess.
A Croaking Cryptid#056.dst: 好啦，有什麼問題就趕快問吧，我想。
A Croaking Cryptid#056.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#057.src: Well, where did you come fro
A Croaking Cryptid#057.full: Well, where did you come from?

A Croaking Cryptid#058.src: Or smoke cigars. Or drink.. er.. what's this stuff called? Auburn Absinthe? Yeah.
A Croaking Cryptid#058.dst: 也不會抽雪茄。也不會喝……呃……這玩意兒叫啥來著？Auburn 苦艾酒？對。
A Croaking Cryptid#058.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#059.src: Not that I crrrroakin' care... Drinks and cigars are enough to keep me happy. Plus the thrill of scarin' off idiot citizens, heh.
A Croaking Cryptid#059.dst: 我也不是他呱～～的在乎啦……有酒喝、有雪茄抽，我就夠開心了。再加上嚇跑那些蠢老百姓的快感，嘿。
A Croaking Cryptid#059.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#060.src: Let's jus'... move on from 'at. Got anythin' else to say?
A Croaking Cryptid#060.dst: 咱們就……別再提那個了。還有啥要說的嗎？
A Croaking Cryptid#060.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#062.src: As I said earlier, dey ain't been payin' me lately, so dey can shove it.
A Croaking Cryptid#062.dst: 我剛才說過了，他們最近都沒付我錢，所以去他們的吧。
A Croaking Cryptid#062.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#063.src: Er. Got anythin' else to say?
A Croaking Cryptid#063.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#065.src: What's 'e do, teach the crrrroakin' alphabet?
A Croaking Cryptid#065.dst: 他是做啥的，教他呱～～的字母喔？
A Croaking Cryptid#065.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#067.src: Pal, were you crrrroakin' high or somethin'?
A Croaking Cryptid#067.dst: 老兄，你那時是他呱～～的嗑嗨了還是怎樣？
A Croaking Cryptid#067.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#068.src: Er. Awkward. Got anythin' else to say?
A Croaking Cryptid#068.dst: 呃。真尷尬。還有啥要說的嗎？
A Croaking Cryptid#068.speaker: Croaquin

Maex Black Market#001.src: I see you've come to my pottery shop. Feel free to browse, but our pottery classes are full.
Maex Black Market#001.dst: 看來你來到了我的陶藝店。歡迎隨意看看，不過我們的陶藝課已經額滿了。
Maex Black Market#001.speaker: Shopkeeper

Maex Black Market#002.src: Aha! There it is. A Phoenix Egg. This'll fetch a high price.
Maex Black Market#002.dst: 啊哈！就在那裡。一顆鳳凰蛋。這能賣個好價錢。
Maex Black Market#002.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#004.src: You there, back away and pretend like this never happened.
Maex Black Market#004.dst: 你，退後，就當什麼都沒發生過。
Maex Black Market#004.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#005.src: Good, they didn't follow... I'll be back for more soon...
Maex Black Market#005.dst: 很好，他們沒跟上來……我很快就會再回來拿更多……
Maex Black Market#005.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#006.src: Hey, why are you following me?! Knock it off!
Maex Black Market#006.dst: 喂，你幹嘛跟著我？！別跟了！
Maex Black Market#006.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#007.src: Seriously, creep, you need to go away.
Maex Black Market#007.dst: 說真的，怪胎，你給我走開。
Maex Black Market#007.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#008.src: GET THE HELL AWAY FROM ME!!
Maex Black Market#008.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#009.src: *pant* Aha! There! Can't get to me now, can you?
Maex Black Market#009.dst: *喘氣* 啊哈！好了！現在抓不到我了吧？
Maex Black Market#009.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#010.src: The poacher punches a control panel on the inside of the elevator.
Maex Black Market#010.dst: 盜獵者一拳打在電梯內側的控制面板上。
Maex Black Market#010.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#014.src: Actually, I just remembered, we have a slot open.
Maex Black Market#014.dst: 其實，我剛想起來，我們還有一個空位。
Maex Black Market#014.speaker: Shopkeeper

Maex Black Market#015.src: If you'd like to attend one of our *cough* "Pottery classes", head through the door behind me.
Maex Black Market#015.dst: 如果你想參加我們的 *咳* 「陶藝課」，就從我身後那扇門進去。
Maex Black Market#015.speaker: Shopkeeper

Maex Black Market#016.src: Woah there, would you be interested in buying my totally gnar happy-juice?
Maex Black Market#016.dst: 哇喔，等等，你有沒有興趣買我這超讚的快樂果汁？
Maex Black Market#016.speaker: Hallucinogen Merchant

Maex Black Market#017.src: You can say no, it's totally chill.
Maex Black Market#017.dst: 你可以說不，完全沒差啦。
Maex Black Market#017.speaker: Hallucinogen Merchant

Maex Black Market#018.src: No need to be so harsh.
Maex Black Market#018.speaker: Hallucinogen Merchant

Maex Black Market#019.src: Chill out, brother. We're all one. Just swing by whenever you wanna have a group vibe session.
Maex Black Market#019.dst: 放輕鬆，兄弟。我們都是一體的。想一起來場集體共振的時候，隨時過來晃晃。
Maex Black Market#019.speaker: Hallucinogen Merchant

Maex Black Market#020.src: Hello, hello. I zee you ave come to zee my finest collection of priceless and rare dark artifacts.
Maex Black Market#020.dst: 泥好，泥好。窩看泥是來參觀窩介批最精美、無價又稀有滴黑暗神器收藏的。
Maex Black Market#020.speaker: Dark Artificer

Maex Black Market#021.src: Come! Come and vonder at awe-inspiring relics!
Maex Black Market#021.dst: 來！來讚嘆介些令人嘆為觀止滴遺物吧！
Maex Black Market#021.speaker: Dark Artificer

Maex Black Market#022.src: Oooo... I zee you have a keen eye. I am zure you ave noticed the weapon on the vall and its fine craftsmanship.
Maex Black Market#022.dst: 喔喔喔……窩看泥眼光很銳利。窩想泥一定注意到牆上那把武器，還有它精湛滴工藝了。
Maex Black Market#022.speaker: Dark Artificer

Maex Black Market#023.src: Ze Kirschblute! Outlawed in zeventy zhree jurisdictions. Ze owners have a tendency to go... vell, to their not happy place.
Maex Black Market#023.dst: 就素 Kirschblute！在七十三個司法管轄區都被列為禁品。它滴主人們往往會去……嗯，去他們不太開心滴地方。
Maex Black Market#023.speaker: Dark Artificer

Maex Black Market#024.src: Come get your genuine phoenix eggs! Gen-u-ine! Gen- NO, IT'S YOU AGAIN! GET AWAY!
Maex Black Market#024.dst: 來買正宗的鳳凰蛋喔！正——宗——的！正——不，又是你！滾開！
Maex Black Market#024.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#025.src: You see this fine selection of frozen Doguns behind me?
Maex Black Market#025.dst: 看到我身後這批精選的冰凍 Doguns 了嗎？
Maex Black Market#025.speaker: Dogun Merchant

Maex Black Market#026.src: That's what happens when you douse a Dogun in water. They're still alive, though. Just in exquisite agony.
Maex Black Market#026.dst: 把 Dogun 澆濕就會變成這樣。不過他們還活著。只是處在極致的痛苦之中。
Maex Black Market#026.speaker: Dogun Merchant

Maex Black Market#027.src: However, when we pour lava on them, they unfreeze. Well, they scream. Well, both, actually.
Maex Black Market#027.dst: 不過，只要往他們身上倒岩漿，他們就會解凍。嗯，是會尖叫。嗯，其實兩者都有。
Maex Black Market#027.speaker: Dogun Merchant

Maex Black Market#028.src: Nonono... these aren't normal brews. Deadlock Serum? Morta Maxima? You know what they say... pick your poison.
Maex Black Market#028.dst: 不不不……這些可不是普通的釀品。Deadlock 血清？Morta Maxima？俗話說得好……毒藥自己挑。
Maex Black Market#028.speaker: Brewmaster

Maex Black Market#029.src: Perhaps you need it for some treatment... or a delectable cuisine! Harvested from our "volunteers".
Maex Black Market#029.dst: 說不定你需要它來做些治療……或是做一道美味佳餚！全都採收自我們的「志願者」。
Maex Black Market#029.speaker: Organ Merchant

Maex Black Market#030.src: The best assassin in Gavel comes at a price. So, how much are you willing to pay?
Maex Black Market#030.dst: Gavel 最頂尖的刺客可不便宜。那麼，你願意付多少？
Maex Black Market#030.speaker: Hitman

Maex Black Market#031.src: Stay quiet about this place, alright? If the guards find out, we're toast.
Maex Black Market#031.dst: 這個地方的事別說出去，好嗎？要是被守衛發現，我們就完蛋了。
Maex Black Market#031.speaker: Shopkeeper

Ruler of the Skies#001.dst: 致: 第 {~} 代天空劫掠者女王，{~} AP。

Ruler of the Skies#002.src: Oi, Your Majesty, I hate ta interrupt ya, but we're in a bit of a bad situation out 'ere.
Ruler of the Skies#002.dst: 喂，女王陛下，很抱歉打擾您，但我們這邊的情況有點糟。

Ruler of the Skies#003.src: Ever since those Dwarves opened up the Heights, air traffic has gotten even more scarce. Our power in these parts is diminishing.
Ruler of the Skies#003.dst: 自從那些矮人打通了 Heights，空中往來就更稀少了。我們在這一帶的勢力正在衰退。

Ruler of the Skies#004.src: We ain't able to support ourselves up in our region, so we may need to move operations to the main base. Just a heads up.
Ruler of the Skies#004.dst: 我們在自己的地盤已經撐不下去了，可能得把人馬撤到主基地去。先跟您說一聲。

Solace in Pain#001.dst: 有人想偷偷溜進那棟宅邸。
Solace in Pain#001.full: There's someone trying to sneak into the mansion.

Solace in Pain#005.src: I have something else to rep
Solace in Pain#005.full: I have something else to report.

Solace in Pain#006.dst: 我可以跟 Zhiraok 談談嗎？

Solace in Pain#007.src: This seems to be Zhiraok's journal. There's more in the room to investigate,. though. Might be wise to come back to this afterwards.
Solace in Pain#007.dst: 這似乎是 Zhiraok 的日誌。不過房間裡還有其他東西可以調查。或許先去看看，之後再回來讀比較好。
Solace in Pain#007.speaker: Diary

Solace in Pain#008.src: Maybe this will make more sense if you read in the proper order...
Solace in Pain#008.dst: 照正確的順序讀，或許會比較看得懂……
Solace in Pain#008.speaker: Diary

Solace in Pain#009.src: Hello? Xao? I thought I heard someone up here.
Solace in Pain#009.dst: 有人嗎？Xao？我好像聽到樓上有人。
Solace in Pain#009.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solace in Pain#010.dst: ……是我剛才把這個放在外面的嗎？
Solace in Pain#010.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solace in Pain#012.src: He would never have left my office out of order like this.
Solace in Pain#012.dst: 他絕不會把我的辦公室弄得這麼亂。
Solace in Pain#012.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solace in Pain#013.src: Who the helix is in here?!
Solace in Pain#013.dst: 到底是哪個螺旋的傢伙在這裡？！
Solace in Pain#013.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solace in Pain#014.src: Reach your endpoint! I've got some problems myself.
Solace in Pain#014.dst: 直接推到結論！我自己也有一堆問題要解。
Solace in Pain#014.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solace in Pain#015.src: ...that's a greater value than my concerns, for sure. Alright, follow my lead.
Solace in Pain#015.dst: ……那確實比我的顧慮重要多了。好，跟著我行動。
Solace in Pain#015.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solace in Pain#017.src: It's probably safe to read some of the journal before he comes back.
Solace in Pain#017.dst: 趁他回來之前讀一點日誌，應該還算安全。

Solace in Pain#018.src: This seems to be Zhiraok's journal. Maybe there's some insight on him in here.
Solace in Pain#018.dst: 這似乎是 Zhiraok 的日誌。也許裡面能看出一些關於他的端倪。
Solace in Pain#018.speaker: Diary

The Legend of Bob#000.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter I: {~} years after the portal was first opened, {p} suffered one of the largest raids ever recorded on western soil.
The Legend of Bob#000.dst: Bob 的傳說 - 第一章: 門首度開啟後 {~} 年，{p} 遭遇了西境有史以來記載規模最大的一次襲擊。

The Legend of Bob#001.src: Although the famous forts of {p} and {p} were deemed impenetrable, this was unfortunately not the case when seas of monsters brought by the curse came knocking on the front gate.
The Legend of Bob#001.dst: {p} 與 {p} 那兩座著名的堡壘一向被認為固若金湯，可惜當詛咒帶來的怪物大軍湧到城門前時，事實並非如此。

The Legend of Bob#002.src: Despite having fought for centuries in the cursed war, {p}'s army numbers were high and many a men laid down their lives to protect the families within the walls.
The Legend of Bob#002.dst: 儘管已經在這場受詛咒的戰爭裡打了幾百年，{p} 的軍隊人數依然可觀，許多人為了保護城牆內的家人獻出了性命。

The Legend of Bob#003.src: However, the sheer numbers pressed against the door broke the hinges and the large gate fell into the bridge, and the largest horde recorded entered the city.
The Legend of Bob#003.dst: 然而怪物的數量實在太多，門軸終究被擠斷，那扇巨大的城門砸落在橋上，有史以來記載最龐大的獸潮就這樣湧進了城裡。

The Legend of Bob#004.src: Many of the residents were slaughtered, maimed or infected by the onslaught of creatures, those able to run hid in the sewers, a vast series of tunnels that run out of the city, and into the foulest place the humans could create, their prison.
The Legend of Bob#004.dst: 許多居民在這場衝擊中被殺害、被殘害，或是遭到感染；還跑得動的人躲進了下水道——那是一整片延伸出城外的巨大隧道，通往人類所能造出最污穢的地方: 他們的監獄。

The Legend of Bob#005.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter II: The idea was to combine two of the most horrible things, the untreated sewage, and the dark cells containing Wynn's worst criminals, to add to their suffering.
The Legend of Bob#005.dst: Bob 的傳說 - 第二章: 當初的構想，是把兩樣最可怕的東西湊在一起——未經處理的污水，和關著 Wynn 最凶惡罪犯的黑牢——好讓他們受更多的罪。

The Legend of Bob#006.src: It really was a horrid place, but in a time like this, it was the safest place to be, and the women and children sought refuge in its stench.
The Legend of Bob#006.dst: 那確實是個可怕的地方，但在那樣的時刻，它卻是最安全的去處，婦孺們就在那股惡臭裡尋求庇護。

The Legend of Bob#007.src: During the fight, a woman who never said her name, nor where she had come from (she certainly wasn't one of {p}'s own) gave birth to a baby boy on the cold floors of the sewer.
The Legend of Bob#007.dst: 戰鬥期間，一名從未說出自己名字、也沒說自己從哪裡來的女子 (她肯定不是 {p} 本地人)，在下水道冰冷的地上生下了一個男嬰。

The Legend of Bob#008.src: Though the women accompanying her did all they could, the unknown woman did not survive the childbirth.
The Legend of Bob#008.dst: 陪在她身邊的婦人們盡了一切努力，那名無名女子還是沒能撐過生產。

The Legend of Bob#009.src: The horde lasted {~} days and the sewer folk did not know if the baby would make it, the conditions were so rotten.
The Legend of Bob#009.dst: 獸潮持續了 {~} 天，下水道裡的人不確定那個嬰兒能不能活下來——環境實在太惡劣了。

The Legend of Bob#010.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter III: Against all the odds, the child made it, suffering no more but a smudge of dirt across his cheek, to everyone's amazement, he was adopted by {p}'s poorest resident, a single mother named Momo.
The Legend of Bob#010.dst: Bob 的傳說 - 第三章: 出乎所有人意料，那孩子活了下來，身上除了臉頰一道髒污什麼事也沒有。更讓大家驚訝的是，收養他的竟是 {p} 最窮的居民——一位名叫 Momo 的單親母親。

The Legend of Bob#011.src: He worked in a local bakery carrying bread and cake into the palace, taking whatever he could get away with.
The Legend of Bob#011.dst: 他在當地一家麵包坊做事，負責把麵包和蛋糕送進宮裡，能神不知鬼不覺摸走的，他都順手摸走。

The Legend of Bob#012.src: Despite his mother being poor, she was none the less intelligent, and taught the child, who she named Robert, everything she knew, taught him to read, write and to a degree, to fight.
The Legend of Bob#012.dst: 他的母親雖然窮，人卻很聰明。她替這孩子取名 Robert，把自己會的一切都教給他——識字、寫字，還有一些打鬥的本事。

The Legend of Bob#013.src: Robert was never a popular lad, always treated differently, his skin was a shade of grey unnatural to those of {p}, who have always been fair skinned.
The Legend of Bob#013.dst: Robert 從來不是受歡迎的孩子，總是被另眼看待。他的膚色帶著一層灰，對一向皮膚白皙的 {p} 人來說很不自然。

The Legend of Bob#014.src: As such he didn't have many friends and wasn't held particularly well among the older citizens either.
The Legend of Bob#014.dst: 因此他沒什麼朋友，在年長的居民之間也不怎麼受待見。

The Legend of Bob#015.src: When he was {~} years old, a horde found its way into the city once more, like it did just over a decade before.
The Legend of Bob#015.dst: 在他 {~} 歲那年，獸潮再一次攻進了城裡，就像十幾年前那樣。

The Legend of Bob#016.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter IV: Although far smaller than its predecessor, the horde was none the less a threat as {p}'s army was so wounded from the last encounter.
The Legend of Bob#016.dst: Bob 的傳說 - 第四章: 這次的獸潮規模比上一次小得多，威脅卻不減——{p} 的軍隊在前一場衝突裡傷得太重了。

The Legend of Bob#017.src: The beacons were not lit from the scouts, and caught the entire city by surprise. Not Robert though, he always keeps a knife he stole from the butchers in his belt to protect the ones he loves.
The Legend of Bob#017.dst: 斥候沒有點燃信標，整座城都被打了個措手不及。Robert 卻不然——他腰帶上一直別著一把從肉舖偷來的刀，為的就是保護他所愛的人。

The Legend of Bob#018.src: Being so poor, Momos shack was on the outskirts of {p} and was one of the first to get hit, Robert ran for the house, finding it empty, but hearing a gasping from below.
The Legend of Bob#018.dst: 因為太窮，Momo 的棚屋蓋在 {p} 的邊緣，也是最早遭殃的地方之一。Robert 一路跑回家，屋裡空無一人，卻聽見底下傳來喘息聲。

The Legend of Bob#019.src: Entering the cellar, he found his mother lying bleeding beside a recently stabbed creature. He went to her aid, knowing it would be in vain.
The Legend of Bob#019.dst: 走進地窖，他看見母親倒在血泊裡，身旁是一隻剛被刺死的怪物。他上前想救她，心裡卻明白那是徒勞。

The Legend of Bob#020.src: She simply nodded at him, they had made an agreement when Robert was {~} years old that if she ever became infected she wanted him to end her life, rather than endure the gruesome prolonged infection that had no cure.
The Legend of Bob#020.dst: 她只是朝他點了點頭。在 Robert {~} 歲那年，他們就約定好了: 萬一她被感染，她要他親手結束她的性命，而不是去承受那種無藥可醫、又漫長又可怕的病變。

The Legend of Bob#021.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter V: Momo placed in Robert's hands a piece of parchment with a crude blood stained drawing of {~} areas each with a strange name under it he hadn't heard of.
The Legend of Bob#021.dst: Bob 的傳說 - 第五章: Momo 把一張羊皮紙塞進 Robert 手裡，上頭是一幅沾了血、畫得粗糙的圖，畫著 {~} 個地方，每個底下都寫著他沒聽過的怪名字。

The Legend of Bob#022.src: In the fires of the fight, Robert fled from the city, wielding not his butcher's knife, but a pair of pitch black knives encrusted with symbols that glowed a purple colour, a cloak and a pouch holding what little food was left in the house.
The Legend of Bob#022.dst: 在戰火之中，Robert 逃出了城。他手裡拿的不再是那把肉舖的刀，而是一對漆黑的匕首，上頭鑲著發出紫光的符號；此外還有一件斗篷，和一個裝著家裡僅剩糧食的小袋。

The Legend of Bob#023.src: He headed east, to the sandy area indicated by his mother's drawing, the one with the knife symbol, and the number "{~}".
The Legend of Bob#023.dst: 他往東走，前往母親圖上標示的那片沙地——畫著匕首符號、旁邊寫著「{~}」的那一處。

The Legend of Bob#024.src: When Robert reached it, he found one man, who did nothing but held out his hand, and Robert placed the only thing of value to him, the dark daggers in his hand.
The Legend of Bob#024.dst: Robert 抵達之後，只見到一個人。那人什麼也沒做，只是把手伸了出來；Robert 便把自己唯一值錢的東西——那對暗色匕首——放進他掌心。

The Legend of Bob#025.src: The man began to tell Robert of what he must now do to aid in the war; he must travel to the {~} masters of Wynn province, to learn their magic and skill if he is to lend his hand in the cursed war.
The Legend of Bob#025.dst: 那人開始告訴 Robert，想在這場戰爭裡出一份力，接下來該做什麼: 他必須走訪 Wynn 行省的 {~} 位大師，習得他們的法術與技藝。

The Legend of Bob#026.src: Only once he had mastered one skill would he be given the key that the next master would accept.
The Legend of Bob#026.dst: 唯有精通了一項技藝，他才會拿到下一位大師願意收下的那把鑰匙。

The Legend of Bob#027.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter VI: After {~} years of training to become an assassin, Robert was now {~} years old and incredibly powerful. The master, Chak, who had taught him, told him his time was now up with him and he would have to progress to learn Archer.
The Legend of Bob#027.dst: Bob 的傳說 - 第六章: 經過 {~1} 年的刺客訓練，Robert 已經 {~2} 歲，強得驚人。教導他的大師 Chak 告訴他，兩人的緣分到此為止，他該去學弓手了。

The Legend of Bob#028.src: Chak took Robert's daggers, to which the handles began to glow bright and moulded together to form a large sheen bow, to which he strung a thick strand of his own hair.
The Legend of Bob#028.dst: Chak 接過 Robert 的匕首，兩支刀柄開始發出亮光、融成一把光亮的大弓，他再用自己一束粗髮當作弓弦。

The Legend of Bob#029.src: Chak handed it back to him, and said "even the most experienced soldier must start from scratch when learning a new mastery". And it was true, Robert was not equipped to deal with any creature that faced him, he'd never even fired a bow!
The Legend of Bob#029.dst: Chak 把弓遞還給他，說: 「再老練的戰士，學新的技藝時都得從頭開始。」這話沒錯——當時的 Robert 根本應付不了任何一隻擋在他面前的怪物，他連弓都沒射過！

The Legend of Bob#030.src: Robert began his journey further south; past the blizzards into a pocket of land he'd never seen on any map the bow symbol with the number "{~}" accompanying it.
The Legend of Bob#030.dst: Robert 繼續往南走，穿過暴風雪，來到一塊他在任何地圖上都沒見過的角落——圖上畫著弓的符號，旁邊寫著「{~}」。

The Legend of Bob#031.src: It was home to only one building, a large mansion, to which a man stood with his hands outstretched as Robert approached.
The Legend of Bob#031.dst: 那裡只有一棟建築，一座大宅。Robert 走近時，一個人正張開雙手站在那兒。

The Legend of Bob#032.src: Just like {~} years previous, Robert handed him the bow, to which he said "I am Mael, master of archery, let us begin. Just as you progress, as does the war."
The Legend of Bob#032.dst: 就像 {~} 年前那樣，Robert 把弓交了過去。那人說: 「我是 Mael，弓術大師。開始吧。你在進步，戰爭也在進行。」

The Legend of Bob#033.src: To which Robert spent a further {~} years mastering the art of crafting and firing arrows, in any situation and learning the magic surrounding the bow.
The Legend of Bob#033.dst: 於是 Robert 又花了 {~} 年，精通在任何情況下製箭與射箭的技藝，也學會了圍繞著弓的那些法術。

The Legend of Bob#034.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter VII: In this time, Robert also learnt about the areas he trained in, Mael was incredibly spiritual; the mansion in which he lived in was also house to many spirits which found Mael to heal them.
The Legend of Bob#034.dst: Bob 的傳說 - 第七章: 這段期間，Robert 也認識了他受訓的那些地方。Mael 極重靈性，他住的那座大宅同時也收容了許多前來求他療癒的亡靈。

The Legend of Bob#035.src: Robert learnt about the other side and how many of the fallen soldiers return cursed to fight on the other side, to which Robert secretly hoped he was able to communicate with his deceased mother.
The Legend of Bob#035.dst: Robert 學到了關於彼岸的事，也知道有多少陣亡的士兵會受詛咒歸來、替另一邊作戰。他心裡偷偷希望，自己能藉此和過世的母親說上話。

The Legend of Bob#036.src: However, Robert never expressed these desires, and Mael told him the time had come to learn some magic that involved no physical weapon that you could hit people with.
The Legend of Bob#036.dst: 不過 Robert 從沒把這份念頭說出口。Mael 告訴他，該去學一種不靠實體武器打人的法術了。

The Legend of Bob#037.src: Robert handed over his bow, to which a familiar glow transformed it into a pure black rod, with the same purple markings around them.
The Legend of Bob#037.dst: Robert 交出了那把弓，熟悉的光芒再次亮起，把它變成一根純黑的長杖，上頭同樣佈滿紫色的紋路。

The Legend of Bob#038.src: Robert looked at the old, frayed map, to see the next area with a single line in it, and the number "{~}", except this time, he knew what area that was.
The Legend of Bob#038.dst: Robert 看向那張又舊又破的地圖，下一個地方畫著一道線，旁邊寫著「{~}」——只是這一次，他知道那是哪裡了。

The Legend of Bob#039.src: It was the forest he passed through when he was {~} years old to get to the desert to begin his training, he barely made it. For the first time since he began his training, Robert was filled with fear.
The Legend of Bob#039.dst: 那是他 {~} 歲那年前往沙漠開始受訓時穿過的森林，當時他差點沒能走出來。自從受訓以來，Robert 第一次感到恐懼。

The Legend of Bob#040.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter VIII: The forest was full of spiders and poison, and the thought of poison always reminded him of the time he... well, never mind that. Robert set off to the forest wielding a stick that was about as much use as a hollowed out pumpkin.
The Legend of Bob#040.dst: Bob 的傳說 - 第八章: 那座森林裡滿是蜘蛛和毒物，一想到毒，他就會想起那次他……算了，這個就別提了。Robert 出發前往森林，手裡拿著一根跟挖空的南瓜差不多有用的棍子。

The Legend of Bob#041.src: He couldn't for the life of him make it work. Regardless, when he reached the forest, he entered a mystical village suspended in the trees lit by hanging lamps, to which the familiar sight of a man with his hand outstretched grasped the wand Robert laid in his hand.
The Legend of Bob#041.dst: 他怎麼樣都沒辦法讓它起作用。無論如何，抵達森林之後，他走進了一座懸在樹上、由吊燈照亮的神祕村落；那個伸著手的熟悉身影再次出現，握住了 Robert 放進他掌心的魔杖。

The Legend of Bob#042.src: "You are half way through your journey, do not let frustration warp you, let us begin the hardest of all arts." were the first words, Ethe, the magical master had ever said to him.
The Legend of Bob#042.dst: 「你的旅程已經走了一半，別讓挫折扭曲了你。我們來開始所有技藝中最難的那一項吧。」這是魔法大師 Ethe 對他說的第一句話。

The Legend of Bob#043.src: And it was certainly true, wand lore had not come so easily to him as knavery or archery had.
The Legend of Bob#043.dst: 這話一點也不假——魔杖之道對他而言，遠不如偷雞摸狗或弓術那樣得心應手。

The Legend of Bob#044.src: However the arts of magic eventually flowed through him over the coming {~} years, to which point Robert was now {~} years old, and beginning to wonder if he would ever remain young enough to fight in the war.
The Legend of Bob#044.dst: 不過在接下來的 {~1} 年裡，法術的技藝終究還是在他身上流轉開來。此時 Robert 已經 {~2} 歲，開始懷疑自己還來不來得及以年輕之軀投入這場戰爭。

The Legend of Bob#045.src: Ethe told Robert it was time to move on, and transformed his wand into its final form, a giant black spear, even his mature eyes gleamed at the sight of it, the spear was the weapon of {p}, the greatest fort man had ever created.
The Legend of Bob#045.dst: Ethe 告訴 Robert 該啟程了，並把他的魔杖變成最後的型態: 一柄巨大的黑矛。連他那雙歷經世事的眼睛，看到它時都亮了起來——矛正是 {p} 的兵器，那是人類造過最偉大的堡壘。

The Legend of Bob#046.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter IX: The map indicated that he must travel to {p}, where the last spear symbol and the number "{~}" were written. Upon arrival, Robert was surprised; the city had been hit — hard.
The Legend of Bob#046.dst: Bob 的傳說 - 第九章: 地圖指示他前往 {p}，最後那個矛的符號和數字「{~}」就寫在那裡。抵達之後，Robert 大吃一驚——那座城遭到重創。

The Legend of Bob#047.src: He'd never heard of {p} so much as receiving a scratch from the creatures, it was so well guarded, but then again, Robert had been absent from civilization for {~} years.
The Legend of Bob#047.dst: 他從沒聽說 {p} 被那些怪物傷過哪怕一道刮痕，那裡守得太嚴實了；不過話說回來，Robert 已經有 {~} 年沒有回到文明世界。

The Legend of Bob#048.src: In the fires, a man stood with his hand out stretched, completely ignoring the pleads of the people around him begging for help, to which Robert placed his spear.
The Legend of Bob#048.dst: 烈火之中，有個人伸著手站在那裡，完全無視周圍民眾的求救。Robert 把矛放進了他手裡。

The Legend of Bob#049.src: The man said "This is the final leg of your journey, let the plights of this town that you see here today force you onward with your training, and help protect this land when you are done. My name is Fier, Let us end your training."
The Legend of Bob#049.dst: 那人說: 「這是你旅程的最後一段。讓你今天在這座城裡看見的苦難，推著你把訓練走完；等你學成，就回頭守護這片土地。我叫 Fier，我們來結束你的訓練吧。」

The Legend of Bob#050.src: Robert spent the next {~} years learning the skills surrounding the spear in the great city of {p}, rebuilding and defending it when necessary in his spare time.
The Legend of Bob#050.dst: 接下來 {~} 年，Robert 在 {p} 這座大城裡學習與矛有關的一切，閒暇時則幫忙重建，必要時參與防守。

The Legend of Bob#051.src: It was the first time he was with people, and by people, I mean people that aren't strict masters of their art that seem to solely exist to teach Robert the ways of the soldier.
The Legend of Bob#051.dst: 那是他第一次跟人相處——我說的人，是指那種不是嚴厲的技藝大師、不像是只為了教 Robert 當兵而存在的人。

The Legend of Bob#052.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter X: Robert learnt to love the people he was around, and people called him Bob, rather than Robert, a girl told him "I don't know, I think you just sound better when you're called Bob."
The Legend of Bob#052.dst: Bob 的傳說 - 第十章: Robert 學會了去愛身邊的人，而人們叫他 Bob，不叫 Robert。有個女孩對他說: 「不知道欸，我覺得叫你 Bob 聽起來比較順。」

The Legend of Bob#053.src: Robert liked it, and when he met new people, he introduced himself as thus.
The Legend of Bob#053.dst: Robert 喜歡這個名字，之後認識新的人，他都這樣自我介紹。

The Legend of Bob#054.src: Fier's training after {~} long years had finally come to an end, to which he said this: "You are now the strongest soldier this province has ever seen, use your power wisely, and you shall end this war."
The Legend of Bob#054.dst: 漫長的 {~} 年之後，Fier 的訓練終於結束。他說: 「你現在是這個行省有史以來最強的戰士。好好運用你的力量，你將終結這場戰爭。」

The Legend of Bob#055.src: Then, to his surprise, all the masters materialised in a line beside Fier, and smiled, Mael even nodding slowly at him, to which a voice behind him said "Why are you crying Bob? There's no one there..."
The Legend of Bob#055.dst: 接著，讓他意外的是，所有大師都現身在 Fier 身旁排成一列，朝他微笑，Mael 甚至還緩緩對他點了點頭。這時身後傳來一個聲音: 「Bob，你哭什麼？那裡根本沒有人啊……」

The Legend of Bob#056.src: The {~} masters vanished and Bob knew what he must now do, return to {p} to save what little is left of it.
The Legend of Bob#056.dst: {~} 位大師隨即消失。Bob 明白自己接下來該做什麼——回到 {p}，救下那裡僅存的一切。

The Legend of Bob#057.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter XI: Bob then spent the remainder of his life serving as Wynns private demigod, destroying all creatures that ever came near a settlement under his protection.
The Legend of Bob#057.dst: Bob 的傳說 - 第十一章: 此後 Bob 用餘生充當 Wynn 的專屬半神，凡是靠近他所守護聚落的怪物，一律殲滅。

The Legend of Bob#058.src: He did not pass on his skills, in fear they would not be used for the greater good, which troubled him. For if he were to pass, who would replace him?
The Legend of Bob#058.dst: 他沒有把自己的本事傳下去，怕那些力量不會被用在正途上——這件事一直讓他放心不下。因為萬一他走了，誰來接替他？

The Legend of Bob#059.src: Certainly not his {~} companions, the animals which he loved dearly, perhaps he would brew them a potion, prolonging their life; they were good animals after all.
The Legend of Bob#059.dst: 肯定不會是那 {~} 個同伴——他深愛的那些動物。或許他該替他們熬一帖藥，延長他們的壽命；畢竟他們都是好動物。

The Legend of Bob#060.src: Bob's story quickly became a huge beacon of hope for many fighting the war; no one could defeat Bob and his dark weapons.
The Legend of Bob#060.dst: Bob 的故事很快成了許多參戰者心中巨大的希望之光——沒有人打得倒 Bob 和他那些暗色的武器。

The Legend of Bob#061.src: However, this is where the story becomes myth, I'm afraid. After over a century of fighting, Bob vanished in the year {~} AP (After Portal).
The Legend of Bob#061.dst: 不過恐怕從這裡開始，故事就進入傳說的範疇了。在打了一個多世紀之後，Bob 於開門後 {~} 年(AP)消失了。

The Legend of Bob#062.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter XII: It was rumoured he heard of a beast corrupting the province, promoting the war and increasing the strength of the monsters.
The Legend of Bob#062.dst: Bob 的傳說 - 第十二章: 據傳他聽說有一頭巨獸正在腐敗這個行省，煽動戰爭，讓怪物變得更強。

The Legend of Bob#063.src: I imagine Bob probably sought to destroy it, but in his old age, perhaps he wasn't up to the mark.
The Legend of Bob#063.dst: 我猜 Bob 大概是想去把他除掉，只是人已年邁，或許力有未逮。

The Legend of Bob#064.src: It was then, though, just one year after his disappearance, Bobs tomb appeared in the snow, marking the place where he was buried.
The Legend of Bob#064.dst: 然而就在他失蹤一年之後，Bob 的墓出現在雪地裡，標示著他的埋骨之處。

The Legend of Bob#065.src: By whom? No one knows. Perhaps it was the killer? Or maybe it was his master's magic? It still lies there today, holding his body, it is worth a visit, many have told of great adventures and magic surrounding the place.
The Legend of Bob#065.dst: 是誰立的？沒有人知道。或許是殺他的人？也可能是他某位大師的法術？那座墓至今仍在那裡，安放著他的遺體，值得走一趟——不少人說過那附近有精彩的冒險與法術。

The Legend of Bob#066.src: One thing is for sure, Bob truly was the master of the Wynn arts, and will forever go down in our history as the mightiest soldier.
The Legend of Bob#066.dst: 有一件事是確定的: Bob 確確實實是 Wynn 諸般技藝的大師，也將永遠以最強戰士之名留在我們的歷史裡。

The Legend of Bob#067.src: Perhaps one day, someone will follow in his footsteps.
The Legend of Bob#067.dst: 或許有一天，會有人追隨他的腳步。
